chunks: The venerable Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah al-Barqi narrated to us, from his father Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Abu al-Bakhtari Wahb ibn Wahb, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from Umm Salama (may Allah be pleased with her):

That she woke up one day crying. So it was said to her: What is the matter with you? She said: My son al-Husayn (peace be upon him) has indeed been killed, and I had not seen the Messenger of God (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) since he died except this night. So I said: May my father and mother be sacrificed for you! Why do I see you looking so pale and haggard? He said: I have not ceased since tonight digging the grave of al-Husayn and the graves of his companions.

key_terms.شاحبا: Pale, haggard -- describing the Prophet's distressed appearance in the dream vision
key_terms.قبر الحسين: The grave of al-Husayn -- symbolic of the Prophet's direct involvement in honoring the Karbala martyrs

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad appear to Umm Salama in a dream about the martyrdom of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: Umm Salama, wife of the Prophet (S), woke up crying one day. When asked what troubled her, she said al-Husayn (AS) had been killed, and she had not seen the Messenger of Allah (S) in a dream since his death until that very night. In the dream she said to him: May my parents be sacrificed for you! Why do you look so pale and haggard? He replied: I have been digging the grave of al-Husayn and the graves of his companions since tonight. This narration powerfully conveys the Prophet's intimate grief over the martyrdom of his grandson, showing his continued spiritual bond with his family even after death.

en.bilal-muhammad: The venerable Shaykh Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abu `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us from his father Muhammad b. Khalid from Abu’l Bakhtari Wahab b. Wahab from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as) from Umm Salama (ra):

that she started crying one day. So, she was asked: What’s the matter with you? She said: My son, al-Husayn (as) has been killed and I haven’t seen the Messenger of Allah (s) since he died save this night. So, I said: May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you! Why is it that I see you so looking so haggard and pale? He said: I have been digging the grave of al-Husayn and the graves of his companions since this night.
